title: 第23章 精血妙用第24章 拖延反杀
lines: 在沧玄大陆，修炼者们提升实力的方式有很多种。
其中最普遍的方式，便是提升修为，以及使用秘法及各类资源凝练肉身，更进一步提升肉身强度。
传闻中有专攻肉身修炼的大能，甚至能做到以肉体之躯比肩灵宝。
更有肉身超神者，滴血重生、万法不侵也不在话下。
只不过，对于绝大多数修炼者来说，凝练肉身只有自身修为达到一定程度之后才能开始。
并且因为肉身一道的特殊性，想要有所成就，所花费的资源更是比正常修炼所需花费的资源高了无数倍，甚至理论上上不封顶。
用通俗的话来讲，这就是个只有氪金大佬才碰的起的玩意儿。
以江尘家这一穷二白的情况，就更是想都不敢想。
然而神龙武魂的存在，却完全打破了这一常规。
理论上来说，只要吞噬的野兽足够多，所凝练的精血完全足以填补肉身修炼所需要的资源空缺。
而且江尘所获得的精血十分精纯，再加上武徒期就开始修炼肉身，足以和那些天资超凡，家世显赫，从出生起便开始使用各种天材地宝打基础的天才们拉近差距。
“先来试试效果吧！”
搞清楚精血的作用以后，江尘便立刻开始运转功法炼化精血。
整个炼化过程十分流畅。
经过武魂提纯过的精血，其中没有夹杂一丝杂质，宛如天生的“无主”
之物，轻而易举的与江尘的肉身融合，强化滋润着身体各处。
短短一分钟，精血便炼化完毕，江尘能够清晰地感觉到，自己的力量的确增强了一些。
不过或许是精血数量太少，这种增长十分有限。
“看来还是要让精血和妖丹多积累一些，再一次性吸收突破。”
“不然仅靠这一点精血和能量，修炼起来刚刚有点感觉就强行中断，着实难受。”
江尘意犹未尽的起身之后，便将在地上打滚儿玩耍的武魂收了回去，重新拿起长剑寻找下一个目标。
三个时辰以后。
天色近晚，江尘找到一个较为隐蔽的山洞，将洞口封起来，盘膝而坐。
随后唤出武魂，将包裹里的妖丹全部取出。
一共二十多个白色妖丹，其中大小不一，最大的足有玻璃球那么大，最小的则仅比绿豆大一些，这便是江尘这三个时辰的收获。
除此之外，武魂腹中也积累了三十多滴精血。
经过一番吞噬后江尘发现，精血的凝结数量与所击杀妖兽的大小成正比。
身体越庞大，提炼的精血越多。
妖兽的等级，则与精血质量有关。
无论如何，这些资源暂时足够江尘修炼了。
“夜间的苍庐森林太过危险，今夜先正常修炼，等明日再去狩猎更多妖兽。”
做好决定以后，江尘便开始修炼。
先将妖丹全部喂给武魂。
等到妖丹凝练成精纯灵气之后，江尘丹田之中瞬间出现了海量灵气。
灵气数量之多，甚至令江尘明显有种“撑到”
的感觉。
随后，江尘便立刻引导着这股灵气，开始向下一条经脉发起冲击。
一条、两条。
等到江尘开始冲击第三条经脉时，因为灵气略有不足，以冲击失败而告终。
江尘对此也不失望，继续开始炼化精血。
content_en:
In Cangxuan Continent, there are many ways for cultivators to improve their strength.
The most common way is to improve one's cultivation and use secret techniques and various resources to condense the physical body and further enhance the strength of the physical body.
There are rumors that there are powerful people who specialize in physical cultivation, and can even rival spiritual treasures with their physical bodies.
There are also those who are super gods in the flesh, who can be reborn with a drop of blood and are invulnerable to all means.
However, for the vast majority of cultivators, condensing the physical body can only begin after their own cultivation reaches a certain level.
And because of the special nature of the physical body, if you want to achieve something, the resources you spend are countless times higher than those required for normal cultivation, and there is no limit in theory.
In layman's terms, this is something that only krypton money bosses can afford.
Considering the poor situation of Jiang Chen's family, it is even more unthinkable.
However, the existence of Shenlong Wuhun completely broke this convention.
Theoretically, as long as enough beasts are devoured, the condensed blood essence is enough to fill the resource gaps needed for physical training.
Moreover, the blood essence and blood Jiang Chen obtained was very pure, and he had begun to cultivate his physical body since his martial arts apprenticeship, which was enough to close the gap with those geniuses who had extraordinary talents, prominent family backgrounds, and had used various heavenly materials and earthly treasures to lay the foundation since birth.
"Let's try the effect first!"
After understanding the role of essence and blood, Jiang Chen immediately began to use his skills to refine the essence and blood.
The entire refining process is very smooth.
The essence and blood purified by Wuhun do not contain a trace of impurities, just like being born "without a master"
The thing easily merged with Jiang Chen's body, strengthening and moisturizing every part of his body.
In just one minute, the essence and blood were completely refined, and Jiang Chen could clearly feel that his strength had indeed increased.
However, perhaps because the amount of blood essence is too small, this growth is very limited.
"It seems that we still need to accumulate more blood essence and demon elixir, and then absorb the breakthrough at once."
"Otherwise, it would be really uncomfortable to just rely on this little essence, blood and energy and forcefully interrupt the practice just when you feel a little bit."
After Jiang Chen stood up without finishing his thoughts, he took back the martial spirit that was rolling and playing on the ground, and picked up the sword again to look for the next target.
Three hours later.
It was getting late, so Jiang Chen found a relatively secluded cave, sealed the entrance and sat cross-legged.
Then he summoned his martial spirit and took out all the demon pills in the package.
There were more than twenty white demon pills in total, of different sizes. The largest one was as big as a glass ball, and the smallest one was only bigger than a mung bean. This was Jiang Chen's harvest in these three hours.
In addition, Wuhun also accumulated more than thirty drops of blood essence in his belly.
After some devouring, Jiang Chen discovered that the amount of condensed blood essence was proportional to the size of the monster killed.
The bigger the body, the more essence and blood can be extracted.
The level of the monster is related to the quality of its blood essence.
In any case, these resources are enough for Jiang Chen to practice for the time being.
"The Canglu Forest at night is too dangerous. Let's practice normally tonight and hunt more monsters tomorrow."
After making the decision, Jiang Chen began to practice.
First feed all the demon pills to Wuhun.
After the demon pill was condensed into pure spiritual energy, a massive amount of spiritual energy instantly appeared in Jiang Chen's dantian.
The amount of spiritual energy was so large that Jiang Chen clearly felt like he could "last it"
feeling.
Afterwards, Jiang Chen immediately guided this spiritual energy and began to attack the next meridian.
One, two.
When Jiang Chen started to attack the third meridian, the attack ended in failure due to a slight lack of spiritual energy.
Jiang Chen was not disappointed with this and continued to refine blood essence.
title_en: Chapter 23 The Magical Use of Essence and Blood Chapter 24 Delaying the Counterattack
